# The reconciliation normalization gap is visible in current source

Insertion normalizes names, but current Reconcile compares childNames directly to stored childName before the normalized lookup/insert phase. Its TODO explicitly calls for NFC-normalized childNames. A decomposed equivalent name can therefore take the delete/reinsert branch in this static algorithm. The inspected reconciliation test uses a precomposed siblîng and does not test this case. Record it as a conditional source concern; no ID change, data loss or runtime failure was reproduced. Static source and test-code inspection only. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator timeline and inline discussion remains pending. No runtime or live accessibility result is claimed.

Scope: Panorama Unicode reconciliation.
